title: To rename the Oyster Bay National Wildlife Refuge as the Congressman Lester Wolff Oyster Bay National Wildlife Refuge.
official_summary: This bill designates the Oyster Bay National Wildlife Refuge near Oyster Bay, New York, as the "Congressman Lester Wolff National Wildlife Refuge."

summary.headline: A 2020 law renames the Oyster Bay National Wildlife Refuge in New York after former Congressman Lester Wolff.
summary.what_it_does: The law changes the official name of the wildlife refuge near Oyster Bay, New York, to honor former Congressman Lester Wolff. The bill's official title and its summary use slightly different wording for the new name, so the exact final name is not fully clear from these sources. The change does not create new rules, funding, or services for visitors.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 27, 2020.
